subject: Mental Models
title: Conditional Probability
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Conditional Probability.

hook.text: What is the chance you carry an umbrella? Now what if I told you it is raining? The second number is very different.

buildup.text: Conditional probability is the likelihood of event A given that event B has already occurred.

discovery.text: Thomas Bayes formalized this in the 1700s. The probability of a cause shifts when you learn about its effects.

climax.text: Always update your estimates when new evidence arrives.

quiz.question: What is conditional probability?
options: The chance of two events happening at once
The likelihood of one event given another has occurred
The probability that conditions remain unchanged
